actual_file_scope: The complete current corollary, proof and remaining-types remark read in full; the final binom typography in D.PM.8 observed.
checks: The matrix-algebra semilinear conjugation representation is faithful over F_p: the scalar centre detects the field automorphism and the full matrix algebra detects the remaining scalar kernel.
Induction from the bounded-index normal subgroup preserves faithfulness without semisimplicity or division by the index, giving d_S=O(log|S|) for the stated simple families and fixed exceptions.
The centreless socle has trivial centralizer, so conjugation embeds G into its automorphism wreath products; the direct-sum representation has dimension O(log|G|).

Maroti Theorem 1.1 has exactly the three cases used. In its alternating-product case, each G-orbit product of alternating factors is minimal normal, so the socle hypothesis bounds m through the fixed finite collection. The resulting order bound is O((1+log N)^2).

The intrinsic matrix-model theorem then gives the displayed eighth-power logarithmic type budget. The fixed finite simple collection, alternating-isomorphism exclusion in the unbounded Lie family, and lack of arbitrary imprimitive/cross-characteristic scope are explicit.
